target_company.name: Canva
target_company.description: Web-based graphic design platform with AI-powered tools for individuals and teams

peer_selection.rationale: Selected creative software and collaboration platform companies. Adobe is included despite size difference as closest comparable for design tools.

special_considerations: Massive user base of 240M MAU with strong freemium model
Strong pricing power - raised Canva Teams from $300 to $500/year
Competing directly with Adobe in democratized design space
notes.data_quality: ARR and revenue from company announcements and Sacra estimates. EBITDA estimated at ~10.6% net profit margin.
notes.valuation_context: August 2025 secondary at $42B continues upward trend from $32B (Oct 2024) and $26B (Apr 2024). Peak was $40B in 2021.
notes.comparability_notes: Canva's freemium model and consumer+enterprise hybrid is unique. Adobe is much larger but serves similar market. Monday.com represents collaboration platform comparison.
